titulo: New Extraction of the Cosmic Birefringence from the Planck 2018 Polarization Data
abstract: We search for evidence of parity-violating physics in the Planck 2018 polarization data and report on a new measurement of the cosmic birefringence angle β. titulo: Cosmic Birefringence as Fossilized Bandwidth Decay: A Coherence Framework Derivation
abstract: We derive cosmic birefringence — the observed ~0.2-0.35 degree rotation of CMB polarization — as a structural consequence of coherence bandwidth decay in the RMAxt framework.
